title: Add delta-correlation performance profiling and auto-release digest
author: Asha Patel
description:
Motivation: When new model variants are onboarded we often see subtle regressions or improvements that are hard to tie back to specific metadata or micro-changes in the model bundle. This PR introduces a delta-correlation profiler that correlates changes in model metadata and binary diffs with shifts in performance profiles (latency P95, token throughput, memory high-water marks) observed under a synthetic load probe. The outcome is twofold: 1) structured performance deltas attached to a model version and 2) an autogenerated, human-readable release digest for changelogs and release notes.

Design summary: The feature has three components: (A) delta_correlation analyzer - lightweight statistical correlator that consumes profiled metrics and model-diff signals, (B) synthetic_prober - a reproducible load generator integrated into the onboarding pipeline that runs short, bounded workloads (microbenchmarks + representative sequences) and emits canonical histograms and KV-cache traces, (C) release_digest generator - templates and heuristics that synthesize a digest combining semantic changelog lines (from commit messages/manifest annotations) and prioritized perf deltas with remediation hints.

Scope & constraints: The prober is designed to run as an optional step during onboard (default disabled for quick onboarding) and as a scheduled job in CI for nightly profiles. Correlation is intentionally conservative: we annotate deltas with confidence bands and attach example traces rather than claim causality.

What changed (high level): - Add registry/service/profiles/delta_correlation.py: core correlator and CLI wrapper. - Add registry/telemetry/prober/synthetic_prober.py: reproducible microbenchmark harness. - Add schemas/model_profile_v2.json: extended profile schema with delta entries and confidence metadata. - Add scripts/release/generate_digest.py: release digest composer and short-text summarizer. - Add CLI glue: cli/onboard/benchmark_sampler.py to invoke prober during onboard. - Add web preview: webapp/components/release_digest_preview.tsx to show digest in UI. - Add docs: docs/onboarding/delta_profiles.md describing interpretation and limitations. - Tests: tests/test_delta_correlation.py, tests/test_prober_integration.py. - Add minimal telemetry masking and opt-out hooks for customer data (telemetry/README).

Checklist (done): - [x] Implementation of correlator and prober - [x] Model profile schema bump (v2) with migration script - [x] Unit tests for correlator math and edge cases - [x] Integration test that runs prober in a sandbox container - [x] Release digest templates and examples - [x] Docs and short UX preview - [x] Telemetry privacy review and opt-out flag

Acceptance criteria / QA steps: 1) Run the onboard flow with --with-prober against a test model; verify a model_profile v2 JSON has a "deltas" block with perf metrics and confidence. 2) Generate a release digest for a release candidate: produced markdown should include a concise perf-summary, top-3 deltas, and suggested remediation if a perf regression is high-confidence. 3) Synthetic prober must complete within configured time budget (default 3 minutes) and not mutate model artifacts. 4) CI nightly job demonstrates stability for a fixed set of models (no more than 1% variance in reported medians between runs).

Rollout plan: Feature off by default. Toggle via onboarding flag and an account-level config. Nightly profiling enabled for internal canary accounts first, then opt-in for enterprise customers. Monitor: new metrics exported to telemetry namespace reg.delta_correlation.* (histograms for score/confidence, probe durations, and digest generation success). Alert on increased digest failures or probe runtime > 3x budget.

Backward compatibility: schema bump to model_profile_v2 includes a migration shim; older consumers will continue to read profile.v1 until they migrate. Release digests are additive and stored as separate artifacts under releases/<model>/digest-<version>.md.

Security & privacy: prober explicitly masks prompt content and avoids sending customer data to external services. Telemetry events are aggregated and privacy-reviewed; opt-out flag documented.

Notes: The correlator intentionally avoids heavy ML models and uses bootstrap sampling + Spearman rank correlation with Holm-Bonferroni correction to reduce false positives. We include an examples folder and two canned digests for maintainers to inspect.

release_notes: Introduce delta-correlation profiling and optional synthetic probing during model onboard. Adds model_profile v2 with structured deltas and an autogenerated release digest summarizing performance changes and recommended remediation. Feature is opt-in and off by default.
notes_for_backport: No backport planned; this changes schema (v2) and requires migration. If backporting to a maintenance branch, include migration shim and opt-in flag only.
